response.sql: WITH oc AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), avg_all AS (SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" o WHERE o.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account)) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS a), kept AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.cnt FROM oc, avg_all WHERE oc.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account) AND oc.cnt > avg_all.a), avg_kept AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS k FROM kept) SELECT kept.account_id, kept.cnt AS order_count, kept.cnt - avg_all.a AS diff_above_overall_avg, kept.cnt - avg_kept.k AS diff_above_kept_avg FROM kept, avg_all, avg_kept ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Overall average = total orders (on accounts present in account) divided by the count of all accounts in account, so accounts with no orders count as zero.
Ties in the sort at the 10-row cutoff are broken arbitrarily, since the request gives no tie-breaker.
